upstream.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent animated companion sprite for a desktop hybrid 3D learning-room scene
Input image: Image 1 is the source and exact subject reference.
Primary request: isolate only the small glowing blue-white round companion character and its small dark circular pedestal from the desktop near the brass lamp.
Composition/framing: preserve the companion's exact front three-quarter appearance, proportions, face, soft cyan glow, tiny sparkles, and pedestal. Center the isolated subject with tight but safe transparent padding.
Style/medium: preserve the same warm hand-painted 3D illustration rendering as the source.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with alpha; no desk, lamp, notebook, paper, room, shadow rectangle, text, watermark, extra character, or new ornament. Preserve soft semi-transparent outer glow without a white or dark halo.

reproducibility.note: Re-encoding the recorded PNG with the recorded sharp options produced the exact runtime byte count and SHA-256.

review.note: This encoded derivative inherits the source asset's unresolved authorship and release-license review.
